## Authorization check

Substantive contributions are accepted only by prior written invitation.

- [ ] I have prior written authorization to submit this contribution.
- [ ] I own the submitted material or have identified every third-party component and its license.
- [ ] I have not included confidential information, credentials, personal data, or trade secrets.
- [ ] Any required contributor or copyright agreement has been completed.

## Scope

Describe the exact change and link the written invitation or authorization without exposing confidential terms.

## Third-party material

List all third-party sources and licenses, or state `None`.
